title: Surface and near-surface stratigraphy map of the Snelling 7.5-minute quadrangle, Barnwell and Allendale counties, South Carolina
citation: Willoughby, R.H., 1993, Surface and near-surface stratigraphy map of the Snelling 7.5-minute quadrangle, Barnwell and Allendale counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-74, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Surface and near-surface stratigraphy map (1993; revised 2007, cartography 2009), Upper Coastal Plain. Units mapped mainly from geologic drilling; drill-hole labels read on the map face (logs on file at SCGS, not printed, so no intervals or depths). Two labels (5-155, 7-179) have prefixes unlike their neighbours and are marked unclear. No sections. SUBSURFACE: none beyond unit thickness ranges.
